accessibility.title: Mastrao Visio accessibility
accessibility.introduction: This page provides accessibility information for Mastrao Visio.
accessibility.scope: This information concerns the Mastrao Visio instance you are using.

complianceStatus.title: Compliance status
complianceStatus.body: No accessibility audit results for this instance are published on this page. Its level of compliance remains to be assessed.

improvement.title: Report a barrier
improvement.body: If you encounter a barrier, contact your Mastrao representative with the affected page, your browser and a description of the problem.
